results.why: A revolver fired inside the saloon at the bar. A shot out in the street in front of the store, the listeners facing away. Indoors they hear it and know it was outside, out front; nobody knows who without seeing him.
A man shouting in the street. Down an empty street at night a shout carries 60 m and more; in the store 15 m off through its front, yes; at the back of the saloon, maybe.
The player walking the saloon's porch boardwalk, listeners facing away in the street. Boots on hollow boards carry: plain at 2 and 5 m, heard at 9 m on a quiet night, not at 16.
The same walk on the street's packed dirt: a man might catch it at 2 m, not at 5 or 9.
The player thumbs back his hammer in the saloon, the listeners facing away. The click is the sound every Western is built on: plain at arm's length and across a quiet table.
The player running down the street: heard 5 m off, maybe 12; not inside the jail across the way.
